Read the region's settings via config.settings.region(household.region) (following the pattern in distribution/planner.py); if the settings dict has no 'winter_kit' key, return 0 (decide by the setting, not by climate). If it does, compute the household's people with the existing ration_size(household, today) (same household-size rules as food_kits: members with age_on(day) < INFANT_AGE count as INFANT_WEIGHT), take people_per_kit from the winter_kit setting, and return max(1, math.floor(people / people_per_kit)) so every household in a winter_kit region gets at least one kit (minimum floor via max, rounding down via math.floor, mirroring food_kits).", "uses": ["R2", "R3", "R4", "R8"], "after": ["P1"]}, {"id": "P3", "file": "inventory/stock.py", "change": "Add reserve_winter_kits(warehouse_id, qty, household_id). If qty == 0, return None without reserving anything (reserve_stock raises on qty <= 0, so this check must happen first). Otherwise return reserve_stock(warehouse_id, 'WINTER-KIT', qty, 72, household_id=household_id), which validates the SKU against SKUS (WINTER-KIT is already valid), sets the 72-hour hold via expires_at, and returns the Reservation.", "uses": ["R5", "R7"], "after": []}]}}
